content: This too shall pass away into the great silence.
author: Persian Proverbs
sourceWork: In niz bogzarad (این نیز بگذرد) — Attar of Nishapur & Solomon Legend
explanation: King Solomon asked his sages for an inscription on a ring that would make him humble in victory and comforted in sorrow. They engraved: 'This too shall pass.' Neither the pinnacle of earthly fame nor the darkest dungeon of despair is permanent. Meet both with unruffled grace.
practicalInsight: If you are suffering today, whisper 'this too shall pass.' If you are celebrating today, whisper the exact same words.
reflectionPrompt: How does remembering the transience of all worldly states ground your heart in unshakeable peace?
